about: I'm Retired Army Signal NCO and CCNP-certified network engineer. After 18+ years in IT infrastructure, I got tired of watching the people who literally keep the internet running wear generic vendor swag to industry events so I created a new clothing category called infrawear, apparel designed specifically for IT professionals, ethical hackers, and the infrastructure-minded. The brand is Slash-32, named after the /32 CIDR subnet notation that identifies a single unique host.
